# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run references`; edit its sources, not this file. -->

This generated reference is for users authoring or reviewing `cockpit.toml`. It is generated from the schema cockpit validates against, so it matches this version. For the handful of tables a typical cockpit sets, start with [Configuration essentials](configuration-essentials.md).

The same schema ships as JSON Schema in [`cockpit.schema.json`](../packages/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json), installed at `node_modules/@b00dea/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json`; point an editor at it for completion and validation as you type.

## Defaults

The values cockpit uses for a key the configuration leaves out.

```json
{
  "cockpit": {
    "siblings_root": "..",
    "guide_cap": 200
  },
  "sibling": {
    "toolchain": "none",
    "guides": [
      "CLAUDE.md",
      "AGENTS.md"
    ],
    "instruction_pointer": false
  },
  "ports": {
    "step": 100,
    "count": 27
  },
  "guards": {
    "hosted_db_hosts": [],
    "vendor_endpoint_hosts": [],
    "protected_branches": [
      "main",
      "master"
    ],
    "allow": [],
    "deny": []
  },
  "mcp": {
    "allowed_tools": {},
    "approved": {}
  },
  "work": {
    "grading": "independent",
    "attempt_cap": 2,
    "wip_cap": 3,
    "verification_timeout_seconds": 1800,
    "evaluator_timeout_seconds": 900,
    "gates": {}
  },
  "autonomy": {},
  "environment": {
    "resettable_volumes": [],
    "generated_host_paths": [],
    "compose_files": [],
    "profiles": [],
    "entrypoint_derivatives": [],
    "install_policies": []
  },
  "surfaces": {
    "tools": [
      "claudecode",
      "codexcli",
      "opencode"
    ],
    "overlays": [],
    "harnesses": [],
    "bundles": [],
    "adopted": []
  }
}
```

## Tables

Each section is one TOML table: `[name]` holds one, `[[name]]` repeats. A table accepts only the keys it lists unless its rules below say otherwise. Rules are JSON Schema fragments that relate several keys of the same table. A pattern is a regular expression the value must contain a match for; `^` and `$` in it make it cover the whole value. A type that links to a shape is a table whose keys are listed once, under [Shapes](#shapes).

### Top-level keys

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unconfirmed` | Answers no person has stated yet; init writes them and doctor reports them. | array of string |  | 1–12 items; each item: one of `"cockpit.name"`, `"sibling"`, `"estate.runnable"`, `"ports.bases"`, `"environment.install_policies"`, `"environment.test_data"`, `"environment.compose_files"`, `"environment.machine"`, `"environment.posture"`, `"testing"`, `"guards"`, `"work.grading"` |
| `cockpit` | Identity and layout of this cockpit. | table: [`[cockpit]`](#cockpit) |  | required |
| `sibling` | Product repositories the cockpit works across. | array of table: [`[[sibling]]`](#sibling) |  | required; at least 1 item |
| `ports` | Port leasing for running stacks side by side. | table: [`[ports]`](#ports) |  | required |
| `guards` | Rules that restrict what agents may run. | table: [`[guards]`](#guards) | `{}` |  |
| `mcp` | Approval of MCP servers and exact per-server tool restrictions. | table: [`[mcp]`](#mcp) | `{}` |  |
| `work` | How work orders are accepted, graded and closed. | table: [`[work]`](#work) | `{}` |  |
| `autonomy` | Which decisions an agent may take without a person. | table: [`[autonomy]`](#autonomy) | `{}` |  |
| `browser` | Browser automation for the stack. | table: [`[browser]`](#browser) |  |  |
| `testing` | Test stages and gates. | table: [`[testing]`](#testing) |  |  |
| `environment` | How the stack is reached, signed in to, built and kept. | table: [`[environment]`](#environment) | `{}` |  |
| `surfaces` | Instructions, skills and settings generated for agent tools. | table: [`[surfaces]`](#surfaces) | `{}` |  |
| `docs` | Living documents and decision records: docs check keeps them true, and work orders record their decisions there. | table: [`[docs]`](#docs) |  |  |

### `[cockpit]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Name of this cockpit. | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `siblings_root` | Directory holding the sibling checkouts, relative to the cockpit. | string | `".."` |  |
| `guide_cap` | Most lines of always-loaded guidance; preflight fails above it. | integer | `200` | greater than 0; at most 9007199254740991 |

### `[[sibling]]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | Short name of the sibling; also how the root AGENTS.md labels its copied guides. | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `dir` | Checkout directory under the siblings root, or . for the siblings root itself. | string |  | required; either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns)) |
| `remote` | Git remote to clone from; required when acquire is auto or manual and not allowed when none. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `branch` | Branch to check out when cloning. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `mount` | How the stack uses the checkout: always mounted, mounted under a profile, host only, or not mounted. | string |  | required; either (one of `"always"`, `"host"`, `"none"`) or (pattern `^profile:[a-z0-9-]+$`) |
| `acquire` | How the checkout reaches disk: cloned by setup, cloned by a person, or not a repository. | string |  | required; one of `"auto"`, `"manual"`, `"none"` |
| `var` | Name of the exported *_DIR environment variable that points at the checkout. | string |  | required; pattern `^(?!(?:DOCKER_\|COMPOSE_\|LD_\|DYLD_\|LIBPATH$\|SHLIB_PATH$\|NODE_OPTIONS$\|NODE_PATH$\|BASH_ENV$\|ENV$\|PATH$\|IFS$))[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `toolchain` | Toolchain that installs and tests the sibling; none for a directory of data. | string | `"none"` | one of `"node"`, `"python"`, `"ruby"`, `"go"`, `"rust"`, `"dotnet"`, `"none"` |
| `gate` | Set to operator for a lane that touches live data or local hardware; it never runs by default and asks first. | string |  | exactly `"operator"` |
| `host_reason` | Why the sibling cannot join the stack; required when mount is host. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `guides` | Guide files the sibling publishes, copied into the cockpit's root AGENTS.md by sync. | array of string | `["CLAUDE.md","AGENTS.md"]` | each item: pattern [P1](#patterns) |
| `instruction_pointer` | Let setup add a pointer to the cockpit guide in this sibling, when the command line also approves it. | boolean | `false` |  |
| `purpose` | What the sibling is for; printed when its checkout is missing. | string |  | required; at least 1 character |
| `environment_files` | Template and instance environment file pairs the sibling needs. | array of table: [`[[sibling.environment_files]]`](#siblingenvironment_files) |  |  |
| `rebuild_inputs` | Files or directories in the sibling, beyond its lockfiles, whose change leaves a running stack stale, such as a migrations directory. | array of string |  | at most 64 items; each item: pattern [P1](#patterns) |
| `derives` | Facts about the sibling that cockpit derives rows or MCP servers from. | table: [`[sibling.derives]`](#siblingderives) |  |  |

- Must match `{"oneOf":[{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["none"]}},"not":{"required":["remote"]}},{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["auto","manual"]}},"required":["remote"]}]}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}},"required":["host_reason"]},{"properties":{"mount":{"not":{"enum":["host"]}}}}]}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"gate":{"enum":["operator"]}},"required":["gate"]},{"not":{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}}},{"properties":{"purpose":{"pattern":"\\b(?:[lL][iI][vV][eE]|[pP][rR][oO][dD][uU][cC][tT][iI][oO][nN]|[hH][aA][rR][dD][wW][aA][rR][eE]|[sS][iI][mM][uU][lL][aA][tT][oO][rR])\\b"}}}]}}]}`.

### `[ports]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `step` | Offset between consecutive stacks' published ports. | integer | `100` | greater than 0; at most 9007199254740991 |
| `count` | Number of stacks that can run side by side. | integer | `27` | greater than 0; at most 9007199254740991 |
| `bases` | Base host port for each port variable; stack n publishes base plus n times step. | table of integer |  | required; each key: pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`; each value: 1–65535 |

### `[guards]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hosted_db_hosts` | Hosted database host names the guards keep agents away from. | array of string | `[]` | at most 128 items; each item: pattern [P3](#patterns) |
| `vendor_endpoint_hosts` | Real vendor endpoint host names the guards keep agents away from. | array of string | `[]` | at most 128 items; each item: pattern [P3](#patterns) |
| `protected_branches` | Branches the guards keep agents from pushing to or rewriting. | array of string | `["main","master"]` |  |
| `allow` | Commands allowed in addition to the built-in rules. | array of table: [`[[guards.allow]]`](#guardsallow) | `[]` | at most 64 items |
| `deny` | Commands refused in addition to the built-in rules. | array of table, one of: [`[[guards.deny]]` form 1](#guardsdeny-form-1), [`[[guards.deny]]` form 2](#guardsdeny-form-2) | `[]` | at most 64 items |

### `[[guards.allow]]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `argv` | Command prefix, as an argument list, that is allowed. | array of string |  | required; 1–32 items; each item: pattern [P4](#patterns) |
| `reason` | Why the command is allowed. | string |  | required; 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |
| `cwd` | Allow only when run from this directory, relative to the cockpit. | string |  | either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns), at most 4096 characters) |

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prefix` | Command prefix, as an argument list, that is refused. | array of string |  | required; 1–32 items; each item: pattern [P4](#patterns) |
| `reason` | Why the command is refused. | string |  | required; 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |
| `fix` | Safer command or step to suggest instead. | string |  | 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |

### `[[guards.deny]]` form 2

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contains` | Argument sequence that is refused wherever it appears in a command. | array of string |  | required; 1–32 items; each item: pattern [P4](#patterns) |
| `reason` | Why the command is refused. | string |  | required; 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |
| `fix` | Safer command or step to suggest instead. | string |  | 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |

### `[mcp]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_tools` | Exact tool names permitted per declared MCP server. An empty list denies every tool; an absent server has no tool restriction. Review the tool implementation: names and read-only annotations do not establish read-only behavior. Unsupported harnesses receive no restricted server. | table of array of string | `{}` | at most 256 entrys; each key: pattern `^(?=[\s\S]{0,128}$)(?:^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$)`; each value: at most 256 items, unique items, each item: pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$`, at most 128 characters |
| `approved` | Approved MCP servers, each mapped to the sha256 of the declaration a person reviewed; others stay disabled. | table of string | `{}` | each key: pattern `^(?=[\s\S]{0,128}$)(?:^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$)`; each value: pattern `^[a-f0-9]{64}$` |

### `[work]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `grading` | How an order earns done: independent (a separate agent tool process grades it and cockpit reads that process directly), subagent (the working agent relays the verdict of a read-only subagent it spawned, which cockpit cannot verify), checks (cockpit ran every criterion's check and all passed), self (the agent reports met or unmet with a note) or off (the grader is optional: nothing judges and nothing blocks on grading, and the order closes as ungraded). | string | `"independent"` | one of `"independent"`, `"subagent"`, `"checks"`, `"self"`, `"off"` |
| `evaluators` | Agent tools that run the independent grader for work grade and cockpit grade, tried in order: codexcli, claudecode, opencode. Defaults to the tools surfaces.tools lists that can evaluate, in that order, with the tool running the command moved last when it is detected (Claude Code or Codex), so another tool grades first. A list given here is used exactly as written. | array of string |  | 1–3 items; each item: one of `"codexcli"`, `"claudecode"`, `"opencode"` |
| `attempt_cap` | Failed checks or grades before an order is blocked; may be lowered but not raised. | integer | `2` | 1–2 |
| `wip_cap` | Accepted orders that may be unfinished at once; may be lowered but not raised. | integer | `3` | 1–3 |
| `verification_timeout_seconds` | Seconds one criterion's check command may run before it is stopped and reported as not run. | integer | `1800` | 1–7200 |
| `evaluator_timeout_seconds` | Seconds one independent grading run may take before it is stopped. | integer | `900` | 1–7200 |
| `gates` | Who passes each work-order decision. | table: [`[work.gates]`](#workgates) | `{}` |  |

### `[work.gates]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | Who accepts a draft work order: agent, person or ci. Default agent. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `amend` | Who accepts a changed contract. Default agent. Removing an accepted criterion or gate always needs a person or ci; an agent's rewrite of a criterion, scope, non-goal or objective is judged at the next grade, and needs a person under checks grading; under off nothing judges it. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `answer` | Who answers an open question on an order. Default agent. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `signoff` | Who closes a graded order. Default agent. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `acknowledge` | Who acknowledges that an order weakened tests, which checks grading otherwise fails; under independent, subagent and self grading the acknowledgement is context for the verdict, and under off it is only recorded. Default agent. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |

### `[autonomy]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sync` | Who may run a sync that writes: agent, person or ci. Default agent. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `stale_delete` | Who approves sync deleting files cockpit generated before and no longer generates. Default agent. An unchanged MCP-only file of a listed tool whose servers are no longer written goes without this approval, because removing it only narrows access. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `reset` | Who may apply a reset, which deletes stack data. Default person. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"`, `"ci"` |
| `mcp_approve` | Who approves a declared MCP server: person records each digest in [mcp.approved]; agent lets sync enable every declared server as declared, so an agent that writes a sibling MCP source starts that process outside the guard. Default person. | string |  | one of `"agent"`, `"person"` |

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `endpoint` | WebSocket address of the browser server, using an allowed loopback host. | string |  | format `uri` |
| `max_clients` | Most browser clients that may connect at once. | integer |  | required; 1–64 |

| `test_files` | Paths and globs, relative to each checkout, that hold tests. Grading fails an order that deletes, skips or loosens what they match. Defaults to common layouts. | array of string |  | 1–64 items; each item: pattern `^(?!\/)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.\.(?:\/\|$))[A-Za-z0-9._@+\-/*?]+$`, 1–512 characters |
| `stages` | Commands that make up the test gates. | array of table: [`[[testing.stages]]`](#testingstages) |  | required; 1–128 items |
| `gates` | Named gates that run stages before handing back changes. | array of table: [`[[testing.gates]]`](#testinggates) |  | required; 1–128 items |
| `native_hooks` | How the repository's own git hooks are handled. | table: [`[testing.native_hooks]`](#testingnative_hooks) | `{"install":"inspect"}` |  |
| `native_hook_policy` | Policy file for installing the repository's hooks; required for explicit-native. | table: [`[testing.native_hook_policy]`](#testingnative_hook_policy) |  |  |

- Must match exactly one of `[{"properties":{"native_hooks":{"properties":{"install":{"enum":["inspect"]}}}},"not":{"required":["native_hook_policy"]}},{"properties":{"native_hooks":{"properties":{"install":{"enum":["explicit-native"]}},"required":["install"]}},"required":["native_hooks","native_hook_policy"]}]`.

## Shapes

These tables recur in several places; each place links here instead of repeating the keys.

### `mechanism` shape

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `module` | Module that implements the capability. | string |  | required; pattern [P1](#patterns); pattern [P6](#patterns); at most 4096 characters |
| `export` | Export of the module that implements the capability. | string |  | required; pattern `^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*$`; at most 128 characters |

### `provenance` shape

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | File or place the value came from, relative to the repository. | string |  | required; pattern [P1](#patterns); at most 4096 characters |
| `observed_on` | Date the source was looked at; required unless kind is declared. | string |  | format `date`; pattern [P2](#patterns) |
| `kind` | How the value was established: declared by this file, measured, or inferred. | string |  | required; one of `"declared"`, `"measured"`, `"inferred"` |
| `reason` | Why the value is what it is. | string |  | required; pattern `\S`; 1–4096 characters |
| `confirmed` | Set to true once a person has confirmed an inferred value; inferred values require it. | boolean |  |  |

- Must match at least one of `[{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["declared"]}}},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["measured"]}},"required":["observed_on"]},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["inferred"]},"confirmed":{"enum":[true]}},"required":["confirmed","observed_on"]}]`.

## Patterns

Long patterns that several keys share, cited by name in the tables.

| Pattern | Regular expression |
| --- | --- |
| P1 | `^(?!\/)(?![A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*\\)(?:[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+\/)*[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+$` |
| P2 | `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))$` |
| P3 | `^(?:\*\.)?(?=[a-z0-9.-]{1,253}(?![\s\S]))[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*(?![\s\S])` |
| P4 | `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f\uD800-\uDFFF]{1,128}(?![\s\S])` |
| P5 | `^(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)(?:-(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?$` |
| P6 | `^(?!.*(?:^\|\/)(?:\.git\|internal\|node_modules)(?:\/\|$)).+$` |
| P7 | `^(?!(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}:)?(?:.*\/)?\.\.?(?:\/\|$))(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}:)?(?![/])[A-Za-z0-9._@+\-/]*[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]$` |

## Checks beyond the schema

cockpit checks these rules when it loads the configuration (`x-cockpit-runtime-checks` in the JSON Schema). An editor validating against the JSON Schema does not report the ones marked in the last column (`x-cockpit-editor-limitations`).

| Path | Rule | Not reported by editors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sibling[].slug` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].dir` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].var` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].environment_files[].instance` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.resettable_volumes[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.resettable_volumes[]` | `declared_compose_volume_key` |  |
| `environment.generated_host_paths[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.compose_files[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.entrypoint_derivatives[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.install_policies[].toolchain+lockfile` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.posture_requirements[].requirement` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.entrypoint_derivatives[].port` | `declared_in_ports.bases` | yes |
| `browser.artifacts` | `exact_environment.generated_host_paths_coverage` | yes |
| `browser` | `matches_environment_addressing_authentication_and_client_cap` | yes |
| `browser.images` | `mcp_driver_shares_major_minor_with_project_driver` | yes |
| `testing.gates[].stages[]` | `references_declared_testing_stage` | yes |
| `sibling[].environment_files[]` | `template_and_instance_differ` | yes |
| `sibling[].derives.mcp_sources[].path` | `unique_within_sibling` | yes |
| `environment.seed` | `requires_resettable_volumes` | yes |
| `ports` | `count_times_base_count_within_shared_input_budget` (limit 4096) |  |
| `surfaces.overlays[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources[].path` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources` | `feature_namespace_and_complete_skill_definitions` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources[].bytes` | `utf8_byte_length_at_most_65536` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].replaces.name` | `matches_declaration_name` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].capabilities` | `one_row_per_surface_feature` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].capabilities[].spelling` | `unique_when_emitted` | yes |
| `surfaces.adopted[].path` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.adopted[].source` | `equals_cockpit/adopted/<path>` | yes |
| `surfaces.adopted[].provenance.kind` | `declared` | yes |

## Skill size limits

Agent tools load every skill's frontmatter into each session and its entry point whenever the skill is used, so cockpit caps both and keeps the detail in a procedure file the agent reads only when it needs it. The limits come from `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/collection.json`, SHA-256 `d5ae65d3f69fbb6a33db2e8a63f93b936a37c8c0566cabdc3f248de6018ed7da`.

| Target | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| claudecode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | each skill's procedure |
| codexcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | each skill's procedure |
| opencode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | each skill's procedure |
| cursor | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | each skill's procedure |
| grokcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | each skill's procedure |

| Skill entry point | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
